papers.title: The gut microbiome and incident atherosclerotic cardiovascular events: Prospective analyses in three Swedish cohorts
papers.translated_title: 肠道微生物组与新发动脉粥样硬化性心血管事件：三项瑞典队列的前瞻性分析
papers.author: Pertiwi, K.
papers.summary: Background: Variation in the gut microbiome composition has been associated with atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease (ASCVD) in case-control designs. We aimed to investigate associations with incident ASCVD events applying a prospective design to reduce the impact of reverse causality. Methods: We assessed associations between gut microbiome features measured by shotgun metagenomic sequencing and incident total ASCVD, ischemic heart disease (IHD) and ischemic stroke, including fatal and non-fatal events as defined by registry follow-up in 17,216 participants from three Swedish population-based cohorts (SCAPIS, SIMPLER, and MOS). Results from Cox proportional hazards regression models adjusted for demographic, and lifestyle factors, medication, and prevalent diabetes were combined across cohorts using a fixed-effect meta-analysis accounting for multiple testing. Associations were tested for replication in HUNT and FINRISK. Results: During a median of 6-8 y follow-up, 769 incident ASCVD events occurred. Species diversity was inversely associated with ASCVD and IHD, with a hazard ratio for IHD of 0.86 per SD increase in species richness (95% CI: 0.79-0.95). Sixty-eight common species (i.e., present in ?30% individuals) were associated with incident IHD after adjusting for sex and birth country, but only eight remained in fully adjusted models, including Ruminococcus_B gnavus. Among others, inverse associations were observed for SFEL01 sp004557245 and Fimadaptatus sp900553645 from Christensenellales, an order in which butyrate production has been reported. Streptococcus mutans and Limosilactobacillus fermentum, oral-associated species previously associated with coronary atherosclerosis, were associated with a higher risk of incident IHD, which remained after adjustment for dental health. Replication analysis in the HUNT study supported the finding for S. mutans. No associations were observed with ischemic stroke. Conclusions: Gut species diversity and specific species abundance were associated with incident IHD, providing evidence supporting a protective role of two Christensenellales species and an adverse role of oral species and R. gnavus in the development of IHD.
papers.translated_summary: 背景：在病例对照设计中，肠道微生物组组成的变异与动脉粥样硬化性心血管疾病（ASCVD）相关。我们旨在采用前瞻性设计研究其与新发ASCVD事件的关联，以减少反向因果的影响。方法：我们评估了通过鸟枪法宏基因组测序测定的肠道微生物组特征与新发总体ASCVD、缺血性心脏病（IHD）和缺血性卒中的关联，包括来自三个瑞典人群队列（SCAPIS、SIMPLER和MOS）的17,216名参与者中由登记随访定义的致死性和非致死性事件。对人口学、生活方式因素、用药和现患糖尿病进行调整的Cox比例风险回归模型结果，通过固定效应荟萃分析在各队列间合并，并校正多重检验。这些关联在HUNT和FINRISK研究中进行了重复验证。结果：在中位6-8年随访期间，发生了769例新发ASCVD事件。物种多样性与ASCVD和IHD呈负相关，物种丰富度每增加1个标准差，IHD的风险比为0.86（95% CI：0.79-0.95）。在调整性别和出生国家后，68种常见物种（即在≥30%个体中存在的物种）与新发IHD相关，但在完全调整模型中仅剩8种，包括Ruminococcus_B gnavus。其中，来自Christensenellales目（据报道该目具有丁酸产生能力）的SFEL01 sp004557245和Fimadaptatus sp900553645观察到负相关。Streptococcus mutans和Limosilactobacillus fermentum——先前与冠状动脉粥样硬化相关的口腔相关物种——与新发IHD风险升高相关，且在调整牙齿健康后仍存在。HUNT研究中的重复分析支持了S. mutans的发现。未观察到与缺血性卒中的关联。结论：肠道物种多样性和特定物种丰度与新发IHD相关，提供了支持两种Christensenellales物种的保护作用以及口腔物种和R. gnavus在IHD发展中的不利作用的证据。

papers.title: Gut microbiome associations with incident cardiovascular disease in Nordic populations
papers.translated_title: 北欧人群中肠道微生物组与新发心血管疾病的关联
papers.author: Wolford, B. N.
papers.summary: Background: The gut microbiome is an emerging risk factor for cardiovascular disease. However, there is a lack of large-scale metagenomic studies with replication that identify gut microbial features associated with incident cardiovascular disease (CVD). Methods: We tested for gut microbiome associations with CVD using metagenomes from stool samples in a discovery-replication framework across four large prospective Nordic cohorts with 635 incident CVD in 11,604 participants in the discovery cohort and 2,309 incident CVD in 20,965 participants combined across three replication cohorts. Results: Higher Shannon diversity index and species richness were consistently associated with a lower risk of incident CVD. In addition, the relative abundance of nine species and eleven bacterial functional modules showed reproducible associations with incident CVD in the discovery cohort and in a meta-analysis of the three replication cohorts. We identified a female-specific gut microbiota-related pathway involving the prevalent oral-gut species Rothia mucilaginosa_A, enriched among denture users, thus serving as a proxy for longstanding poor oral health. Mendelian randomization analysis supported a causal effect of denture use on increased relative abundance of Rothia mucilaginosa_A. This pathway was linked to increased CVD risk through altered gut microbial manganese transport, elevated circulating imidazole propionate levels, and increased levels of systemic inflammation biomarkers. The second pathway involved both ?-diversity metrics and the remaining eight species, all of which were strongly associated with multiple markers of metabolic syndrome and with bacterial pathways related to purine metabolism, microbial stress responses, altered redox balance, ascorbic acid degradation, and branched chain amino acid biosynthesis. Conclusions: These findings demonstrate that gut microbiota diversity, specific taxa, and functional pathways provide new insights into the underlying biology of CVD. Furthermore, these findings suggest that the link between poor oral health and cardiovascular disease may, at least partly, operate through altered gut microbiota.
papers.translated_summary: 背景：肠道微生物组是心血管疾病的新兴危险因素。然而，目前缺乏具有重复验证的大规模宏基因组研究来识别与心血管疾病（CVD）发病相关的肠道微生物特征。方法：我们在一个发现-重复验证框架中，利用四个大型前瞻性北欧队列的粪便样本宏基因组，检验肠道微生物组与CVD的关联。发现队列包含11,604名参与者中的635例CVD发病事件，三个重复验证队列合计包含20,965名参与者中的2,309例CVD发病事件。结果：较高的Shannon多样性指数和物种丰富度始终与较低的CVD发病风险相关。此外，九种物种和十一个细菌功能模块的相对丰度在发现队列以及三个重复验证队列的荟萃分析中均显示出与CVD发病的可重复关联。我们识别出一条女性特异性的肠道微生物群相关通路，涉及常见的口腔-肠道物种Rothia mucilaginosa_A，该物种在义齿使用者中富集，因而可作为长期口腔健康不良的替代指标。孟德尔随机化分析支持义齿使用对Rothia mucilaginosa_A相对丰度增加存在因果效应。该通路通过改变的肠道微生物锰转运、升高的循环咪唑丙酸水平以及升高的全身性炎症生物标志物水平，与CVD风险增加相关联。第二条通路涉及β多样性指标和其余八种物种，所有这些均与代谢综合征的多种标志物以及涉及嘌呤代谢、微生物应激反应、氧化还原平衡改变、抗坏血酸降解和支链氨基酸生物合成的细菌通路强烈相关。结论：这些发现表明，肠道微生物群多样性、特定分类群和功能通路为CVD的潜在生物学机制提供了新的见解。此外，这些发现提示口腔健康不良与心血管疾病之间的关联可能至少部分通过改变的肠道微生物群发挥作用。

papers.title: Aging, Structural, and Neighborhood-Environmental Correlates of Cardiovascular-Kidney-Metabolic Risk Factor Burden Across U.S. Census Tracts
papers.translated_title: 美国人口普查区中心血管-肾脏-代谢危险因素负担的老化、结构和邻里环境相关因素
papers.author: Batobara, A.
papers.summary: Background. The American Heart Association defined Cardiovascular-Kidney-Metabolic (CKM) syndrome in 2023. Census-tract studies often examined one condition without spatial modeling. It is unclear where combined Stage 1-2 burden concentrates and how it relates to aging, environment, and socioeconomic conditions. Methods. We built a CKM burden index for 70,336 tracts from five CDC PLACES crude prevalences (obesity, diabetes, hypertension, hypercholesterolemia, chronic kidney disease) and compared it with NHANES 2017-2020. In 69,530 contiguous-U.S. tracts, we fit Bayesian spatial (BYM2) models with demographic, socioeconomic, and environmental predictors and aging x environment interactions, plus descriptive machine learning. The primary model excluded behavioral measures sharing the outcome's BRFSS source; a second added them. Credible intervals (CrIs) are conditional on PLACES estimates. Results. Agreement with NHANES was modest. Burden clustered spatially (Moran's I = 0.657) and highest in the South. Behavioral measures had the largest machine-learning importance (52.6%), partly from shared sourcing. Each percentage-point increase in adults 65 years was associated with 0.112 units higher burden (95% CrI 0.111-0.113) outside low-income, low-access (LILA) tracts. LILA tracts had 0.10-0.14 units higher burden from the 25th aging percentile but not consistently in the youngest decile. Aging and socioeconomic associations held across sensitivity analyses. The primary model's residual Southern excess approached zero after adding behavioral measures, which may reflect shared measurement, real differences in these behaviors, or both. Conclusions. CKM burden is spatially clustered and highest in the South. LILA tracts had modestly higher burden above the youngest tracts. These cross-sectional estimates support area-level surveillance and needs assessment.
papers.translated_summary: 背景。美国心脏协会于2023年定义了心血管-肾脏-代谢（CKM）综合征。人口普查区研究通常只考察单一疾病，而未进行空间建模。目前尚不清楚合并的1-2期疾病负担集中在何处，以及它如何与老龄化、环境和社会经济状况相关。方法。我们利用五个CDC PLACES粗患病率（肥胖、糖尿病、高血压、高胆固醇血症、慢性肾脏病）为70,336个普查区构建了CKM负担指数，并与NHANES 2017-2020进行了比较。在69,530个美国本土连续普查区中，我们拟合了贝叶斯空间（BYM2）模型，纳入人口学、社会经济和环境预测变量以及老龄化×环境交互作用，并辅以描述性机器学习。主模型排除了与结局共享BRFSS来源的行为测量；第二个模型将其纳入。可信区间（CrIs）以PLACES估计为条件。结果。与NHANES的一致性为中等。负担在空间上聚集（Moran's I = 0.657），且在南部最高。行为测量在机器学习重要性中占比最大（52.6%），部分源于共享数据来源。在低收入、低可及性（LILA）普查区之外，65岁及以上成年人比例每增加一个百分点，与负担升高0.112个单位相关（95% CrI 0.111-0.113）。LILA普查区从老龄化第25百分位起负担高出0.10-0.14个单位，但在最年轻十分位中并不一致。老龄化和社会经济关联在敏感性分析中保持稳健。加入行为测量后，主模型的南部残差超额接近零，这可能反映共享测量、这些行为的真实差异，或两者兼有。结论。CKM负担在空间上聚集，且在南部最高。LILA普查区在最年轻普查区之上负担略高。这些横断面估计支持地区层面的监测和需求评估。

papers.title: Loneliness is associated with 15-year risk of stroke: The Framingham Heart Study
papers.translated_title: 孤独感与15年卒中风险相关：弗雷明汉心脏研究
papers.author: Ekenze, O.
papers.summary: Psychosocial factors are promising candidates as modifiable risk factors for stroke. Loneliness is of interest given its rising prevalence worldwide; yet the temporal relationship of loneliness with subsequent stroke remains unclear. Aim: To clarify the association between timing of loneliness and incident stroke. Methods: Framingham Heart Study participants free of stroke with at least two assessments of loneliness prior to incident stroke (at baseline exam, and at prior exam up to 15 years before baseline) were included. Loneliness was assessed using response to the I felt lonely item on the Center for Epidemiologic Studies Depression Scale, defined as feeling lonely for 3 days within the past week. The recency of loneliness was defined as prior loneliness (present at the prior exam) and baseline loneliness (present at the baseline exam). The primary analysis tested separately for associations between prior loneliness vs no prior loneliness, baseline versus no baseline loneliness, and incident stroke, with 15 years of follow up. Cox models were adjusted for age and sex (model 1) and additionally vascular risk factors (model 2), depressive symptoms (model 3), and physical activity (model 4). Interactions between loneliness and age and sex were explored. Results: Among 4307 participants (mean age 62{+/-}10 years, 55% women), 198 (4.5%) had an incident stroke over a median 6.5-year follow-up period. Prior loneliness was reported by 177 (4.1%) and 226 (5.2%) reported baseline loneliness. Compared to participants without prior loneliness, those with prior loneliness had nearly 3-fold increase in stroke risk after adjustment for age, sex, vascular risk factors, depressive symptoms, and physical activity (HR=2.85, 95% [CI] 1.51-5.39). The effect was primarily observed in participants <80 years (mean age 60 years.HR=3.21, 95% CI 1.69-6.13). No increased risk of stroke was observed among participants with loneliness at baseline. Conclusion: Our findings support consideration of loneliness as a potentially modifiable risk factor, particularly in midlife, for incident stroke.
papers.translated_summary: 心理社会因素是卒中可改变危险因素的有前景的候选因素。鉴于孤独感在全球范围内日益普遍，其值得关注；然而，孤独感与随后卒中之间的时间关系仍不明确。目的：阐明孤独感的时间性与新发卒中之间的关联。方法：纳入弗雷明汉心脏研究参与者，其无卒中，且在发生新发卒中之前至少进行过两次孤独感评估（在基线检查时，以及在基线前至多15年的既往检查时）。孤独感通过流行病学研究中心抑郁量表“我感到孤独”条目的反应进行评估，定义为过去一周内有3天感到孤独。孤独感的时间近因性定义为既往孤独感（在既往检查时存在）和基线孤独感（在基线检查时存在）。主要分析分别检验既往孤独感与无既往孤独感、基线孤独感与无基线孤独感同新发卒中之间的关联，随访15年。Cox模型调整年龄和性别（模型1），并额外调整血管危险因素（模型2）、抑郁症状（模型3）和体力活动（模型4）。探讨孤独感与年龄和性别之间的交互作用。结果：在4307名参与者中（平均年龄62±10岁，55%为女性），198名（4.5%）在中位6.5年随访期内发生新发卒中。177名（4.1%）报告既往孤独感，226名（5.2%）报告基线孤独感。与无既往孤独感的参与者相比，有既往孤独感的参与者在调整年龄、性别、血管危险因素、抑郁症状和体力活动后，卒中风险增加近3倍（HR=2.85，95%[CI] 1.51-5.39）。该效应主要在<80岁的参与者中观察到（平均年龄60岁。HR=3.21，95% CI 1.69-6.13）。在基线时有孤独感的参与者中未观察到卒中风险增加。结论：我们的研究结果支持将孤独感视为新发卒中的潜在可改变危险因素，尤其是在中年期。

papers.title: Optimizing dosing strategies for children with leprosy: A weight-banded dosing approach
papers.translated_title: 优化儿童麻风病给药策略：按体重分层的给药方法
papers.author: van Dyk, J.
papers.summary: BackgroundDosing guidance for children with leprosy remains operationally challenging. For children under 10 years of age, current WHO recommendations rely on mg/kg dosing of the three separate components of leprosy multidrug therapy, which are difficult to implement in routine care and may result in inconsistent drug exposures. Weight-banded dosing offers a pragmatic alternative that better aligns with pharmacokinetic principles and existing drug formulations. MethodologyA pharmacokinetic simulation study was conducted to develop harmonized weight-banded dosing regimens for rifampicin, clofazimine, and dapsone in children aged 2 to <10 years. Using the WHO dosing tool, drug exposures across harmonized weight bands were simulated and adult-equivalent systemic exposure (80- 125% of adult area under the concentration-time curve) targeted. Predicted exposures were contextualized against safety reference regimens used in tuberculosis meningitis, multidrug-resistant tuberculosis, and leprosy. An iterative review process involving the WHO Technical Working Group on leprosy in children ensured clinical and operational feasibility. ResultsProposed weight-banded multidrug therapy regimens achieved adult-equivalent exposures across most weight bands. Predicted exposures modestly exceeded 125% of adult levels at the lower end of selected weight bands but remained well below safety benchmarks, namely exposures associated with daily rifampicin therapy for tuberculosis meningitis and clofazimine regimens for multidrug-resistant tuberculosis. Dapsone exposures were comparable to those achieved with current leprosy dosing. The existing 10-14-year-old child MDT blister pack could be used without modification in children weighing 25-39.9 kg and with limited tablet or gel capsule removal in children weighing 6-24.9 kg. ConclusionsA harmonized weight-banded dosing strategy was developed that enables effective, practical dosing of leprosy multidrug therapy in children under 10 years using existing free-of-charge blister packs provided through WHO. This approach improves dosing consistency, supports programmatic implementation, and provides a rational interim solution while child-friendly formulations are being developed. Author SummaryLeprosy continues to affect children in many low-resource settings, yet guidance on how to dose treatment in younger children remains limited. Current recommendations often require clinicians to calculate mg/kg doses, which can be difficult in practice and may not match the oral formulations that are available. In this study, we used computer-based simulations to develop a simplified dosing approach for the three drugs used to treat leprosy. We showed that grouping children into weight bands, rather than calculating individual doses, can achieve drug exposures similar to those seen in adults, where treatment is known to be effective. Importantly, we found that these doses can be delivered using existing pre-packed treatment kits by removing selected dose units, making this approach practical in routine care. This work provides a more straightforward and reliable way to treat children with leprosy, reducing the burden on clinicians and improving access to treatment. However, challenges remain, including the lack of child-friendly formulations and limited data on how these drugs behave in children. Further studies are needed to improve treatment for this vulnerable population.
papers.translated_summary: 背景儿童麻风病给药指导在操作层面仍具挑战性。对于10岁以下儿童，当前WHO建议依据麻风病多药联合治疗三种独立成分的mg/kg剂量给药，这在常规诊疗中难以实施，并可能导致药物暴露不一致。按体重分带给药提供了一种务实的替代方案，更符合药代动力学原理和现有药物制剂。方法开展了一项药代动力学模拟研究，旨在为2至<10岁儿童制定利福平、氯法齐明和氨苯砜的统一按体重分带给药方案。使用WHO给药工具，模拟了统一体重分带下的药物暴露，并以成人等效全身暴露（成人浓度-时间曲线下面积的80-125%）为目标。将预测暴露与用于结核性脑膜炎、耐多药结核病和麻风病的安全性参考方案进行对照。由WHO儿童麻风病技术工作组参与的迭代审查流程确保了临床和操作可行性。结果所提出的按体重分带多药联合治疗方案在大多数体重分带中达到了成人等效暴露。在所选体重分带的下限，预测暴露适度超过成人水平的125%，但仍远低于安全性基准，即与结核性脑膜炎每日利福平治疗和耐多药结核病氯法齐明方案相关的暴露。氨苯砜暴露与当前麻风病给药所达到的暴露相当。现有的10-14岁儿童MDT泡罩包装可在体重25-39.9 kg的儿童中不加修改使用，在体重6-24.9 kg的儿童中仅需有限地移除片剂或凝胶胶囊。结论制定了一种统一的按体重分带给药策略，使得使用WHO提供的现有免费泡罩包装，能够对10岁以下儿童进行有效、实用的麻风病多药联合治疗给药。该方法提高了给药一致性，支持规划实施，并在开发儿童友好制剂期间提供了合理的临时解决方案。作者摘要麻风病在许多资源匮乏地区仍影响儿童，然而关于年幼儿童如何给药的指导仍然有限。当前建议通常要求临床医生计算mg/kg剂量，这在实践中可能困难，且可能无法与现有口服制剂相匹配。在本研究中，我们使用基于计算机的模拟，为治疗麻风病的三种药物制定了一种简化给药方法。我们表明，将儿童按体重分带分组，而非计算个体剂量，可以达到与成人相似的药物暴露，而成人治疗已知有效。重要的是，我们发现这些剂量可以通过移除选定的剂量单位，使用现有预包装治疗套件来提供，使该方法在常规诊疗中切实可行。这项工作为治疗儿童麻风病提供了一种更直接、更可靠的方法，减轻了临床医生的负担并改善了治疗可及性。然而，挑战仍然存在，包括缺乏儿童友好制剂以及关于这些药物在儿童中行为的数据有限。需要进一步研究以改善这一脆弱人群的治疗。

papers.title: Stroboscopic Light Stimulation in Adults Reporting Depressive Symptoms: Safety, Tolerability, Feasibility, and Active-Comparator Development in a Staged Early-Phase Study
papers.translated_title: 成人报告抑郁症状的频闪灯光刺激：安全性、耐受性、可行性及分阶段早期研究中的活性对照开发
papers.author: Nacker, D.
papers.summary: Stroboscopic light stimulation (SLS) is a candidate non-pharmacological intervention that induces transient visual and affective experiences, with potential application in depression. Before efficacy testing, clinical development requires safety, tolerability, and feasibility data. We report a staged, single-site programme in adults reporting depressive symptoms. Study 1 tested 11 SLS parameter sets for safety and tolerability. Study 2 assessed whether an active comparator reduced subjective visual effects while preserving session context. Study 3 randomised 84 participants to four weekly supervised 31-minute sessions of strobe-emphasis or wash-emphasis SLS. In Study 1, 31 participants were analysed; no severe adverse reactions occurred, mean discomfort was low (0.49/10), and the highest session-level upper 80% confidence limit was 1.13/10, well below the prespecified threshold. Study 2 supported within-participant experiential separation between the two SLS configurations in healthy adults. In Study 3, endpoint data were available for 70/84 randomised participants (83.3%): 39/42 assigned to strobe-emphasis and 31/42 assigned to wash-emphasis. Discomfort remained low, with no serious SLS-attributable adverse events. Both configurations produced visual phenomenology in the Study 3 target sample, and the phenomenological separation observed during Study 2 was not reproduced between groups in Study 3. The comparison estimates differences between two active SLS configurations, rather than SLS versus no stimulation. Exploratory depressive-symptom estimates were imprecise, limited by differential endpoint availability, and should inform endpoint selection and subsequent trial design rather than efficacy. Overall, the programme supports further controlled evaluation of supervised SLS while identifying experiential separation, retention, masking, and endpoint selection as priorities for the next trial.
papers.translated_summary: 频闪灯光刺激（SLS）是一种候选的非药物干预手段，可诱发短暂的视觉与情感体验，在抑郁症中具有潜在应用价值。在开展疗效测试之前，临床开发需要安全性、耐受性和可行性数据。我们报告了一项在报告抑郁症状的成人中开展的分阶段、单中心研究项目。研究1测试了11组SLS参数设置的安全性和耐受性。研究2评估了活性对照是否在保留会话情境的同时减少主观视觉效应。研究3将84名参与者随机分配至每周四次、每次31分钟、有监督的频闪强调型或冲洗强调型SLS会话。在研究1中，共分析31名参与者；未发生严重不良反应，平均不适感较低（0.49/10），会话层面最高的80%置信上限为1.13/10，远低于预设阈值。研究2支持健康成人中两种SLS配置在参与者内体验上的分离。在研究3中，70/84名随机化参与者（83.3%）可获得终点数据：频闪强调组39/42，冲洗强调组31/42。不适感仍然较低，未发生可归因于SLS的严重不良事件。两种配置在研究3的目标样本中均产生了视觉现象学体验，而研究2中观察到的现象学分离在研究3的组间未能重现。该比较估计的是两种活性SLS配置之间的差异，而非SLS与无刺激之间的差异。探索性抑郁症状估计不精确，受终点数据可获得性差异的限制，应作为终点选择及后续试验设计的参考，而非疗效依据。总体而言，该项目支持对有监督SLS开展进一步对照评估，同时将体验分离、保留率、掩蔽和终点选择确定为下一项试验的优先事项。

papers.title: Population-based reference equations and Z-scores for blood biomarkers of neurodegenerative diseases
papers.translated_title: 神经退行性疾病血液生物标志物的基于人群的参考方程与Z评分
papers.author: Lehmann, S.
papers.summary: Background Blood biomarkers are increasingly used to support the diagnosis and monitoring of neurodegenerative diseases. However, their interpretation is complicated by physiological determinants, including age, sex, body-mass index, and renal function, and by differences in absolute concentrations between analytical methods. We aimed to develop population-based reference equations allowing individualized interpretation of selected blood biomarkers blood biomarkers used in neurology. Methods In this cross-sectional study, we analysed plasma samples from cognitively unimpaired participants selected from the French CONSTANCES and Three-City population-based cohorts. Generalized additive models for location, scale, and shape were used to model neurofilament light chain (NfL), glial fibrillary acidic protein (GFAP), phosphorylated tau 181 (p-tau181), amyloid-{beta}40, amyloid-{beta}42, and their ratios according to age, sex, body-mass index, and renal function. The resulting equations provided individualized expected concentrations, percentiles, and Z-scores. Previously established disease-specific concentrations were converted into Z-score. Cross-calibration equations were developed for NfL measurements across analytical methods and sample matrices. Findings The final reference populations comprised 5123 participants for amyloid biomarkers and p-tau181 and 5122 for NfL and GFAP; median age was 52.3 years and 49.7% were women. Between ages 40 and 80 years, expected NfL and GFAP concentrations increased by an average of 2.6% and 2.2% per year, respectively. Renal function, body-mass index, and sex had additional biomarker-specific effects. Application of the equations to clinical cohorts preserved distinct disease-associated profiles: NfL Z-scores were increased across disorders characterized by neuroaxonal injury, whereas p-tau181 and GFAP showed its greatest increase in Alzheimer disease. NfL cross-calibration equations showed excellent agreement between methods and matrices, with intraclass correlation coefficients greater than 0.90. Interpretation This population-based multibiomarker framework enables blood biomarker concentrations to be interpreted relative to individuals with similar physiological characteristics. Publicly available equations, reference curves, and standardized Z-scores could improve individualized interpretation and comparability across biomarkers, laboratories, and clinical populations.
papers.translated_summary: 背景 血液生物标志物越来越多地用于支持神经退行性疾病的诊断和监测。然而，其解读因生理决定因素（包括年龄、性别、体重指数和肾功能）以及分析方法之间绝对浓度的差异而变得复杂。我们旨在开发基于人群的参考方程，以便对神经病学中使用的特定血液生物标志物进行个体化解读。方法 在这项横断面研究中，我们分析了选自法国CONSTANCES和Three-City人群队列的认知未受损参与者的血浆样本。采用位置、尺度和形状的广义相加模型，根据年龄、性别、体重指数和肾功能对神经丝轻链（NfL）、胶质纤维酸性蛋白（GFAP）、磷酸化tau 181（p-tau181）、淀粉样蛋白-β40、淀粉样蛋白-β42及其比值进行建模。所得方程提供了个体化的预期浓度、百分位数和Z评分。先前建立的疾病特异性浓度被转换为Z评分。针对不同分析方法和样本基质中的NfL测量，开发了交叉校准方程。结果 最终参考人群包括5123名淀粉样蛋白生物标志物和p-tau181的参与者，以及5122名NfL和GFAP的参与者；中位年龄为52.3岁，49.7%为女性。在40至80岁之间，预期NfL和GFAP浓度分别平均每年增加2.6%和2.2%。肾功能、体重指数和性别具有额外的生物标志物特异性效应。将这些方程应用于临床队列保留了不同的疾病相关特征：NfL Z评分在以神经轴索损伤为特征的各疾病中均升高，而p-tau181和GFAP在阿尔茨海默病中显示出最大增幅。NfL交叉校准方程显示方法和基质之间具有极好的一致性，组内相关系数大于0.90。解读 这一基于人群的多生物标志物框架使得血液生物标志物浓度能够相对于具有相似生理特征的个体进行解读。公开可用的方程、参考曲线和标准化Z评分可以改善个体化解读以及跨生物标志物、实验室和临床人群的可比性。

papers.title: A multicountry trial-based and model-based economic evaluation of youth mental health interventions: a protocol for assessing the short- and long-term societal impacts of YOUTHreach interventions
papers.translated_title: 基于多国试验和模型的经济评估：YOUTHreach干预对青少年心理健康的短期和长期社会影响评估方案
papers.author: Yaylali, A.
papers.summary: Background Mental health problems among young people impose a burden extending beyond healthcare, including impaired health-related quality of life and high societal costs from disrupted education, lost productivity, and informal care. Youth-friendly interventions may reduce this burden by providing early support and preventing escalation. However, their broader societal economic impact remains insufficiently explored. Evaluations incorporating consequences beyond healthcare and longer time horizons can better capture their societal value. Methods This protocol outlines harmonised trial-based and model-based economic evaluations of YEAH, SELFIE, and MOST, three mental health interventions for young people aged 12-25. Each intervention will be compared separately against care as usual over 12 months, with longer-term costs and outcomes projected at 2, 3, 5, and 10 years. Multicountry participant data will be pooled, using a prespecified reference country for base-case costing and methodological guidance. A harmonised, context-specific Resource Use Measurement instrument was developed to capture healthcare and broader societal resource use consistently across participating countries and to support evaluation of the economic impact of youth mental health interventions from a multicountry perspective. Uncertainty will be assessed through sensitivity and scenario analyses. Discussion The proposed harmonised methodological framework will support consistent estimation of the short- and long-term cost-effectiveness of three youth-friendly mental health interventions. It will enable comparison of intervention-specific results generated using different trial designs and support consistent estimation of costs and outcomes across the three interventions. The context-specific Resource Use Measurement instrument will further support consistent measurement of healthcare utilisation, productivity losses, and informal care across the economic evaluations. Conclusion By integrating trial-based evidence with long-term modelling and standardised measurement of resource use, this study aims to generate robust, policy-relevant evidence to inform health technology assessment and decision-making for youth mental health interventions. The context-specific Resource Use Measurement instrument is also intended to support future economic evaluations of mental health interventions conducted across multiple countries.
papers.translated_summary: 背景 年轻人的心理健康问题造成的负担远超医疗保健范畴，还包括健康相关生活质量受损，以及因教育中断、生产力损失和非正式照护而产生的高额社会成本。面向青年的干预措施可通过提供早期支持和防止问题升级来减轻这一负担。然而，其更广泛的社会经济影响仍缺乏充分探讨。纳入医疗保健之外后果并采用更长时间跨度的评估，能够更好地反映其社会价值。方法 本方案概述了对YEAH、SELFIE和MOST三项面向12-25岁年轻人心理健康干预措施的统一试验基础与模型基础经济学评价。每项干预措施将分别在12个月内与常规照护进行单独比较，并在2年、3年、5年和10年时间点预测更长期的成本与结局。将汇总多国参与者数据，使用预先设定的参考国家进行基准情形成本核算并遵循方法学指南。已开发一种统一的、情境特定的资源使用测量工具，以在参与国之间一致地捕获医疗保健和更广泛的社会资源使用，并支持从多国视角评价青年心理健康干预措施的经济影响。不确定性将通过敏感性分析和情景分析进行评估。讨论 所提出的统一方法学框架将支持对三项面向青年的心理健康干预措施的短期和长期成本效果进行一致估计。它将能够比较使用不同试验设计生成的干预特异性结果，并支持对三项干预措施的成本和结局进行一致估计。情境特定的资源使用测量工具将进一步支持在经济评价中一致测量医疗保健利用、生产力损失和非正式照护。结论 通过将试验基础证据与长期建模及资源使用的标准化测量相结合，本研究旨在生成稳健的、与政策相关的证据，为青年心理健康干预措施的卫生技术评估和决策提供信息。情境特定的资源使用测量工具还旨在支持未来在多国开展的心理健康干预措施经济学评价。

papers.title: A framework for guiding integrated disease control measures through multipathogen surveillance
papers.translated_title: 通过多病原监测指导整合疾病控制措施的框架
papers.author: Bents, S. J.
papers.summary: Global health programs have traditionally focused on single diseases. There is potential for synergy through integrated intervention delivery, particularly in areas with overlapping geographic disease burden, but there is limited methodology developed to guide integration. Here, we propose a framework to translate multipathogen surveillance data into summary indices that can guide integrated program delivery to target multiple pathogens at once. We considered several measures of diversity to quantify multipathogen infection or undervaccination across three large-scale surveys: subregions in Bangladesh (90 clusters, n = 7,187) and Kenya (89 clusters, n = 9,077), and a national survey in Cambodia (100 clusters, n = 2,150). We found that strategies guided by a measure of diversity, Rao's quadratic index, consistently identified more efficient integrated strategies than other multipathogen indices across a range of intervention combinations. We then identified case studies in each setting that used immunization as the backbone for integration and found that incorporating information from co-occurring pathogens led to only modest reductions in efficiency for vaccine-preventable diseases, while affording potentially large gains for other pathogens. Compared with a strategy that prioritized a single vaccine-preventable disease, prioritization using a multipathogen index required targeting 4% (95% CI: 0-12%) fewer spatial clusters in Bangladesh to target four additional pathogens, 10% fewer clusters in Kenya (95% CI: 3-17%), and 11% (95% CI: 5-22%) fewer clusters in Cambodia to reach 80% of all potential intervention beneficiaries across diseases. In all settings, we observed geographic clustering of multiple pathogens, with moderate to high spatial autocorrelation in Bangladesh (Moran's I = 0.58), Kenya (I = 0.56), and Cambodia (I = 0.26), indicating potential for more efficient, spatially concentrated integrated interventions. We also found that a multipathogen index was significantly associated with a multidimensional poverty index in Bangladesh (Spearman's {rho} = 0.25), Kenya ({rho} = 0.51), and Cambodia ({rho}= 0.59), suggesting that multipathogen-guided strategies may effectively target impoverished populations with the highest public health need. The framework provides a systematic approach to guide integrated program delivery, offering potential for greater efficiency in disease control.
papers.translated_summary: 全球卫生项目传统上聚焦于单一疾病。通过整合干预实施存在协同潜力，尤其是在疾病负担地理重叠的地区，但指导整合的方法学发展有限。在此，我们提出一个框架，将多病原监测数据转化为可指导整合项目实施以同时针对多种病原体的汇总指数。我们在三项大规模调查中考虑了多种多样性度量来量化多病原感染或疫苗接种不足：孟加拉国的次区域（90个集群，n=7187）和肯尼亚（89个集群，n=9077），以及柬埔寨的一项全国调查（100个集群，n=2150）。我们发现，以多样性度量——Rao二次指数——为指导的策略在一系列干预组合中始终比其他多病原指数识别出更高效的整合策略。随后我们在每个环境中确定了以免疫为整合骨干的案例研究，发现纳入共现病原体信息仅导致疫苗可预防疾病的效率略有降低，同时为其他病原体带来潜在的大幅收益。与优先针对单一疫苗可预防疾病的策略相比，使用多病原指数进行优先排序在孟加拉国需要针对的空间集群减少4%（95% CI：0-12%）即可覆盖额外四种病原体，在肯尼亚减少10%的集群（95% CI：3-17%），在柬埔寨减少11%（95% CI：5-22%）的集群即可覆盖所有疾病中80%的潜在干预受益人群。在所有环境中，我们观察到多种病原体的地理聚集，孟加拉国（Moran's I = 0.58）、肯尼亚（I = 0.56）和柬埔寨（I = 0.26）具有中到高度的空间自相关，表明更高效、空间集中的整合干预具有潜力。我们还发现多病原指数与多维贫困指数在孟加拉国（Spearman's ρ = 0.25）、肯尼亚（ρ = 0.51）和柬埔寨（ρ = 0.59）显著相关，表明多病原指导的策略可能有效针对公共卫生需求最高的贫困人群。该框架为指导整合项目实施提供了系统方法，为更高效的疾病控制提供了潜力。

papers.title: Hard to Halt: Automation Bias in Agent-Driven Sequencing Prior Authorization Workflows
papers.translated_title: 难以阻止：代理驱动的测序预授权工作流中的自动化偏见
papers.author: Nie, M.
papers.summary: Purpose: Prior authorization (PA) for exome or genome sequencing (ES/GS) is a time-consuming process that impedes timely rare disease diagnosis. Large language model (LLM)-based browser agents offer potential for automating these workflows, but their clinical reliability remains uncharacterized. Methods: We built a sandbox with a simulated ES/GS payer portal and a synthetic electronic health record (EHR) of 836 patient profiles, including compliant profiles and deficient profiles with designed issues. Gemini 3 Pro, Gemini 3 Flash, and Claude Opus 4.5 were evaluated on task completion, form accuracy, and appropriate withholding. Two replication experiments were run on 100 profiles to assess run-to-run variability of agent performance. Results: Gemini 3 Pro (95.5%) and Claude Opus 4.5 (93.7%) completed far more tasks than Gemini 3 Flash (56.1%), consistently across runs. In the first run, all models rarely withheld deficient profiles for the correct reason (Gemini 3 Pro 0%, Gemini 3 Flash 17.3%, Claude Opus 4.5 5.2%). Replication revealed substantial variability: Gemini 3 Pro's correct withholding rose to 28.8-36.8%, and only 18.0-48.0% of tasks yielded identical outcomes across all three runs. Without agentic scaffolding, Gemini 3 Pro flagged designed issues in 91.3% of deficient profiles but also halted on all compliant profiles. Conclusion: Current LLM-based browser agents show a systematic bias toward form submission. A modular, multi-agent architecture with human supervision may be warranted for safe clinical deployment.
papers.translated_summary: 目的：外显子组或基因组测序（ES/GS）的事先授权（PA）是一个耗时的过程，阻碍了罕见疾病的及时诊断。基于大语言模型（LLM）的浏览器代理为自动化这些工作流程提供了潜力，但其临床可靠性仍未被表征。方法：我们构建了一个沙盒，其中包含模拟的ES/GS支付方门户和836名患者档案的合成电子健康记录（EHR），包括合规档案和设计有缺陷的缺陷档案。Gemini 3 Pro、Gemini 3 Flash和Claude Opus 4.5在任务完成、表单准确性和适当保留方面进行了评估。在100个档案上进行了两次复制实验，以评估代理性能的逐次运行变异性。结果：Gemini 3 Pro（95.5%）和Claude Opus 4.5（93.7%）完成的任务远多于Gemini 3 Flash（56.1%），且在各次运行中保持一致。在第一次运行中，所有模型都很少因正确原因保留缺陷档案（Gemini 3 Pro 0%，Gemini 3 Flash 17.3%，Claude Opus 4.5 5.2%）。复制实验揭示了显著变异性：Gemini 3 Pro的正确保留率上升至28.8-36.8%，且仅18.0-48.0%的任务在三次运行中产生相同结果。在没有代理脚手架的情况下，Gemini 3 Pro在91.3%的缺陷档案中标记了设计问题，但也在所有合规档案上停止。结论：当前基于LLM的浏览器代理显示出对表单提交的系统性偏向。为安全临床部署，可能需要一种具有人类监督的模块化多代理架构。
